name: cubemx-user-code-guard
description: Highlights STM32CubeMX generated code and warns when you edit outside USER CODE regions.

cubemxUserCodeGuard.enabled.description: Shade generated lines and warn about edits outside CubeMX USER CODE regions.

cubemxUserCodeGuard.warningCooldownMs.description: Minimum time between edit warnings for the same document.

cubemxUserCodeGuard.userCodeBackground.description: Background color for editable USER CODE lines. Use editor.background to follow the current theme.
